content.title: 不定式 to do 三大用法速查(目的状语 / 后置定语 / 宾语·宾补·主语)
content.intro: 不定式 to do 既能表'为了……'(目的),又能放在名词后表'要做的'(定语),还能作宾语、宾补和主语。口诀:表目的用 to do;名词后修饰用 to do;跟在 want/ask/It is… 后看搭配。

rows: to do = in order to do = so as to do:They make vehicles to carry people into space.
名词 + to do:the first person to go into space;a lot of work to do;something to eat
want/decide/hope/need + to do:He hoped to become an astronaut.
ask/tell/allow/want sb to do:The captain told us to fasten our seatbelts.
It is + adj. + to do:It is dangerous to get out of orbit.

specialRules.rule: 表目的:to do / in order to do / so as to do 三者可互换;否定用 not to do / so as not to do
specialRules.mark: so as not to float around √

specialRules.rule: the first/second/last/only + 名词 + 后,几乎必用不定式
specialRules.mark: the first person to get married in space

specialRules.rule: avoid / enjoy / keep / suggest / mean(意味着)/ be busy / look forward to 后接 doing,不接 to do
It is + adj. + to do 中 It 是形式主语,真主语是后面的 to do
specialRules.mark: It is hard to send people to Mars.

why: 不定式 to do 自带'未来、要去做'的意味,所以最适合表示'目的'和'名词后将要做的动作';而 doing 强调正在进行或一般状态,搭配由前面的动词决定。
gaokaoPoints: 语法填空高频:给动词原形,判断填 to do(目的/定语)还是 doing(avoid/enjoy/keep 等后)。
to do 与 doing 对照题:看前面的谓语动词搭配(want to do vs avoid doing)。
in order to / so as to 表目的,so as to 一般不放句首。

examVsReal.exam: He stayed up late in order to finish the report.（考试/书面）
examVsReal.real: He stayed up late to finish the report.
examVsReal.note: 口语里常直接用 to do,in order to 偏正式

examVsReal.exam: She was the first person to arrive.（考试）
examVsReal.real: She was the first to arrive / the first one there.
examVsReal.note: 口语可省略名词,意思一样
